name: io.github.flow-steward/apache-solr
title: Apache Solr
description: Search and index Apache Solr documents through your own secured MCP server.

instance_host.description: HTTPS hostname for your Apache Solr MCP HTTP server. Not the Solr database endpoint.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Enter Bearer followed by an access JWT from your configured identity provider. Its audience must match this MCP server URL. Replace the token when it expires.
